description: Reads a PDF without changing it: the page count and the size of every page, whether it is password-protected, its document properties, and its form, with every field by its full name, label, type, value and the options it takes. Read it before fill_pdf_form, which takes the fields by these names, and before redact_pdf or split_pdf, which work on these pages. Pass exactly one PDF: source, a render or library file of the workspace; path, a file on this machine; or file_base64. Free on every plan; it creates no render, and an uploaded PDF is read and not kept.

file_base64.description: The PDF itself, base64 encoded, up to 20 MB; sent with the request and not kept

file_name.description: Name of the PDF given as file_base64 or path, e.g. contract.pdf; the results are named after it

path.description: Absolute path of a PDF on this machine, up to 100 MB; sent with the request and not kept

source.description: A PDF of the workspace: the rnd_ id of a PDF render, or a PDF of the file library by name (such as terms.pdf) or fil_ id

name: get_pdf_info

type.description: acroform, hybrid or xfa (which fill_pdf_form refuses); null for a PDF without a form

form.description: The form; null when the file needs a password to open

metadata.description: Title, author, subject, producer and creator; null when unset

pages.description: The size of every page, in points (72 an inch) and millimetres

source.description: The render id or library file name the PDF came from

title: Read a PDF's pages, properties and form
